races.name: Chester Roman Day Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Lucky Luna
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid debut form who should benefit from the expected strong pace
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when debut fourth at Salisbury; can take a step forward over this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: 6-1, shaped well when a debut fourth of 12 in maiden at Salisbury (6f, good) a week ago; this Lucky Vega filly can take a step forward now, especially over this longer trip; very much one to consider.

runners_data.name: Town Queen
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with best form in field but faces pace pressure from multiple rivals
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when runner-up both runs, leading long way at Thirsk latest; a big player
runners_data.spotlight: Blue Point filly who has shaped well when runner-up in 6f Pontefract novice and 7f Thirsk maiden this spring, leading for a long way on latter occasion four weeks ago; she's open to further progress and rates a big player.

runners_data.name: Machadadorp
runners_data.note: Hold-up type from top yard who faded over 1m last time but this trip may suit better
runners_data.comment: Sixth at Ascot on her debut last month; this daughter of Mehmas can build on it here
runners_data.spotlight: 20-1, faded late on when sixth of seven in novice at Ascot (1m, good to firm) on her debut last month; this daughter of Mehmas can build on it here for her leading yard.

runners_data.name: Navona Grey
runners_data.note: Complete unknown making debut for small yard with stamina-laden pedigree
runners_data.comment: The market can guide for this Havana Grey filly on her first run
runners_data.spotlight: 25,000 guineas yearling, 22,000 euros 2yo; half-sister to bumper and 1m3f AW winner Galaxy Star (RPR 90); dam, 11.6f-2m winner (RPR 75), is a half-sister to Australian 1m1f Listed winner Greatwood, out of close relative of Gold Cup winner Fame And Glory; the market can guide for this Havana Grey filly.

runners_data.name: Night Shining
runners_data.note: Improved significantly last time and her hold-up style suits the likely pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Improved when fourth at Yarmouth latest; she can do better still so enters calculations
runners_data.spotlight: Took a big step forward from her debut when fourth of six in 7f Yarmouth novice last month; this daughter of Dark Angel can do better still so enters calculations.

runners_data.name: Imelda
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has shown fair AW form but faces stiff pace competition from Town Queen
runners_data.comment: Placed in two 7f Wolverhampton maidens this spring; may do better still but drawn wide
runners_data.spotlight: Fair form shown when placed in a pair of 7f Wolverhampton maidens this spring, third of 11 on latter occasion; this Invincible Spirit filly may do better still but has a wide draw.

runners_data.name: Danrana
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from long break who needs to show immediate improvement
runners_data.comment: Eighth in maiden at Beverley in August; needs to hit the ground running on her return
runners_data.spotlight: Dandy Man filly who failed to build on her debut fourth when only eighth of 13 in 7.5f maiden at Beverley in August; needs to hit the ground running on her return.

runners_data.name: Elemma
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced prominent type who showed modest improvement last time but needs more
runners_data.comment: Stepped up on debut with fifth at Ripon 13 days ago; handily drawn but more is required
runners_data.spotlight: Daughter of Starman; stepped up on her debut when fifth of eight in 6f Ripon novice 13 days ago; handily drawn but more is required here.

runners_data.name: Tommie's Angel
runners_data.note: Limited ability shown in two runs with apprentice jockey taking valuable weight off
runners_data.comment: Poor form shown in a pair of 6f maidens at Southwell and Pontefract this spring
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form shown in a pair of 6f maidens at Southwell and Pontefract this spring; lots more is required.

runners_data.name: Lc Tiffen
runners_data.note: Poor form to date with claiming rider, drawn to struggle from wide berth
runners_data.comment: Only poor form shown thus far, beating one on her first go in handicaps at Wolverhampton
runners_data.spotlight: Only poor form shown thus far, beating one on her first go in handicaps at Wolverhampton (7f) last month.

runners_data.name: Golden Mabel
runners_data.note: Front-runner with no form of note who may get outpaced early by superior pace rivals
runners_data.comment: Yet to offer much in her four runs, last of seven on her h'cap debut at Wolverhampton
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to offer much in her four runs to date, last of seven on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.5f) 12 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Town Queen, Imelda, and Golden Mabel will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Town Queen's proven front-running ability likely to dominate early proceedings. The pace will be honest throughout the 7f trip on Chester's tight circuit, testing stamina reserves in the final furlong. With three confirmed pace-setters creating pressure up front, this race strongly favours hold-up horses who can sit off the pace and finish with a late kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too fast early and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for Lucky Luna and Night Shining to close from off the pace. Chester's tight turns and the sustained pace will find out the stamina of the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Town Queen can dictate a more measured pace and has the class to sustain her effort
scenarios.body: Her proven ability at this trip and superior form figures give her the best chance to wire the field. The pace may not be as destructive as anticipated if she can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Danrana and Elemma can position themselves perfectly behind the leaders and have enough tactical speed to pounce. Their prominent running styles would be ideal if the pace becomes messy.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Improving Newcomer Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Navona Grey shows significant improvement on debut for the Kelleway yard
scenarios.body: The half-sister to a middle-distance winner could have untapped potential stepping up in trip. Her breeding suggests stamina reserves that others may lack in a truly-run race.

watchPoints.text: Town Queen and Imelda could go too fast early if they engage in a pace duel from the start
Lucky Luna's market move given her debut promise and this race setup strongly favouring hold-up types
Navona Grey's debut performance will indicate if the Kelleway yard has found a live newcomer
Night Shining's ability to handle Chester's tight turns having only raced on conventional tracks previously
The overall pace scenario if Golden Mabel gets involved early creating a three-way speed battle

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Pure Grit
runners_data.comment: 230,000euros yearling by Pinatubo; 8-1, made most when second of ten at Newbury (6f, good)
runners_data.spotlight: 230,000euros yearling by Pinatubo; 8-1, made most when second of ten in Newbury maiden (6f, good) 15 days ago; lots to like if he adapts to this track.

runners_data.name: Deputy Vice
runners_data.comment: £145,000 breeze-up 2yo by Mehmas; one of yard's 2yos is 3-3, including in Lily Agnes here
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000euros foal, 90,000gns yearling, £145,000 breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; Mehmas half-brother to winners Habrdi (6f-1m including 2yo; RPR 92) and Inside Story (6f 2yo; 80); dam once-raced (43) sister to useful 1m/9.4f winner Turnberry Isle, out of Cheveley Park winner Rosdhu Queen; trainer has had two 2yos run this season and one is 3-3, including a Lily Agnes win at this track.

runners_data.name: Dream On Kent
runners_data.comment: By Massaat; late foal but with trainer whose latest 2yos have already made their mark
runners_data.spotlight: By Massaat; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Amber Blossom (7f AW 2yo/7.4f turf; RPR 72) and Not A Sinner (US 6f turf): dam 6f winner (including 2yo/AW; 105), half-sister to Italian 1m1f 2yo Group 3 winner; late foal but with trainer whose latest 2yos have already made their mark.

runners_data.name: Virtuous Star
runners_data.comment: 240,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Starman; stable won this with a newcomer two years ago
runners_data.spotlight: 240,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Starman; second foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Majestic Myles (7f Listed), Parbold (Group-placed 6f 2yo) and Majestic Moon (useful 6f/7f); stable won this with a newcomer two years ago and this is one to note.

runners_data.name: Trust Havana
runners_data.comment: £17,000 breeze-up 2yo by Havana Grey; yard had 2yo winner here (her fourth race) last term
runners_data.spotlight: 85,000euros foal, £17,000 breeze-up 2yo by Havana Grey; first foal; dam placed in Slovakia, half-sister to winners Preferential (1m4f Listed) and Rule Of Nature (6f 2yo), out of maiden half-sister to 7f Group 1 winner Etoile Montante; trainer is better known for jumpers but had a 2yo winner here (her fourth race) last term.

runners_data.name: Blake's Monarch
runners_data.comment: 10-1 at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) when leading until final strides; not the best form though
runners_data.spotlight: 10-1, short-headed in 11-runner novice at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) 19 days ago, leading until final strides; while that was a promising debut and he seemingly has the pace for another bold show from low draw here, others probably bring better form.

runners_data.name: Metamouse
runners_data.comment: 33-1 at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) nine days ago when an always-prominent fourth of 12
runners_data.spotlight: 33-1 for maiden at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) nine days ago when an always-prominent fourth of 12; should improve but has a wide draw and probably some tough company.

runners_data.name: This Moment
runners_data.comment: Pipped at Hamilton; probably among the best form and he could be a lot wiser this time
runners_data.spotlight: Late foal, with useful pedigree for this sort of test; second favourite for six-runner novice at Hamilton (6f, good) 13 days ago but slowly away and a detached last to past halfway, before challenging hard from over 1f out and beaten a head; that's probably among the best form in this and he could be a lot wiser this time.

runners_data.name: Star People
runners_data.comment: Faded to finish towards rear in novice at York (6f, good) 16 days ago but was sent off 8-1
runners_data.spotlight: Faded to finish towards rear in novice at York (6f, good) 16 days ago but was 8-1, so much better was presumably expected of him.

runners_data.name: Caturra Lights
runners_data.comment: Close 3rd at Musselburgh (5f, good) and Chester (5.5f, good); among the best form in this
runners_data.spotlight: Close third in maidens at Musselburgh (5f, good) and Chester (5.5f, good) are both among the best form in this field; a leading contender.

runners_data.name: Moriarty Moon
runners_data.comment: Has a pretty useful pedigree but made a low-key debut at Goodwood (5f, good; 14-1)
runners_data.spotlight: Has a pretty useful pedigree but last of six in novice at Goodwood (5f, good; 14-1) four weeks ago was a low-key debut.

runners_data.name: Koodini
runners_data.comment: Lots went wrong when 13-2 for 5.5f maiden here (good) three weeks ago; now drawn wide
runners_data.spotlight: Suitably bred and nicely drawn for 5.5f maiden here (good) three weeks ago but rather slowly away and hampered twice in the closing stages when he'd got in touch; weak 13-2 that day, while two stablemates (9-4 and 10-1) finished first and second; capable of better but this time has a wide draw.

races.name: Kingkabs Selling Stakes

runners_data.name: Delete Delete
runners_data.note: Debutant from strong yard with decent breeding but selling debut suggests connections' expectations are measured
runners_data.comment: 20,000gns brother to three winners; stable have had a couple of 2yos go close on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000gns yearling; by Massaat; sixth foal; brother to winners Mas Rapido (6f including 2yo/US; RPR 106), Rapido Girl (7f; 74) and Priestess (6f/7f 2yo including AW/Italy; 60); dam placed 5f (including 2yo/AW; 61), half-sister to 5.7f 2yo winner/UAE Oaks runner-up Mary Fildes; stable have had a couple of 2yo newcomers go close; betting to guide.

runners_data.name: Stellar Quest
runners_data.note: Newcomer for in-form Burke stable but early career selling exposure indicates limited immediate potential
runners_data.comment: 16,000euros half-brother to two winners; powerful 2yo stable; commands serious respect
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000euros foal; by Space Traveller; third foal; half-brother to winners Solvency (5f 2yo including AW; RPR 83) and Latin Race (Italian 5f 2yo/6f); dam twice-raced (at 5f; 69) half-sister to Qatari 6f-1m winner Mister Staple; represents a top yard and he is one to take seriously starting out in selling company.

runners_data.name: Shaniko
runners_data.note: First-time hood suggests temperament concerns and trainer struggling for winners this season
runners_data.comment: Only minor appeal on paper and likely best watched on debut; wears a hood
runners_data.spotlight: By Hello Youmzain; first foal of an unraced dam, herself closely related to French 1m4f winner Imperious Man; hooded for debut; best watched.

runners_data.name: Trust In Far
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but showed nothing when tailed off last time, 8-day turnaround suggests desperation
runners_data.comment: Offered little at Haydock eight days ago; no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Slowly away and tailed off in a 6f fillies' maiden at Haydock eight days ago (80-1); no appeal.

runners_data.name: Undercover Affair
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner with solid form figures, 12-day break ideal and trip should suit perfectly
runners_data.comment: Leading form claims now dropping into a seller; draw not ideal but can't discount
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in all three starts, including here, and he ranks highly in calculations judged on RPRs; 6f should be fine but slower than good would be a first and stall 10 tempers enthusiasm too.

runners_data.name: Fortunate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but fades badly in finishes, 10-day gap insufficient to solve stamina concerns
runners_data.comment: Poor form in her three starts and she looked a hard ride latest; easy enough to swerve
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in her three starts, looking a difficult ride at Kempton ten days ago; hard to recommend.

runners_data.name: Claret And Blues
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in trip which should help, but stall 12 is tactical disadvantage
runners_data.comment: Some promise in two 5f novices but he has the widest stall to contend with this time
runners_data.spotlight: He has shown some promise in two 5f novice runs (good ground/Tapeta) and this drop in grade/step up in trip can help; stall 12 no assistance though.

runners_data.name: Happy Humpo
runners_data.note: Hold-up style and poor debut form, 45-day break suggests patience but limited immediate appeal
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on debut (5f) but bred to do better and well drawn; check betting
runners_data.spotlight: 12-1 and always in rear when last of 11 at Beverley last month (5f, good to soft); should do better in time and interesting to see how she fares in the market now dropped into a seller; well drawn.

runners_data.name: Explainingislosing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving with each run, 9-day turnaround and trip increase are positives
runners_data.comment: 6f should suit but comfortably held by Furturra on latest run and poorly drawn
runners_data.spotlight: Signs of ability in two 5f maidens this month, latterly a third of seven at Musselburgh nine days ago; 6f will suit but he has over 4l to make up with Furturra on his latest effort and he is drawn out in stall 11.

runners_data.name: Furturra
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with clear ability at 5f, untried at 6f but profile suggests trip will suit
runners_data.comment: Good second in a 5f maiden nine days ago; up in trip; Oisin Murphy booked; should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Untried at 6f but he has displayed clear promise at shorter trips, finishing a clear second behind a stablemate at Musselburgh nine days ago (5f, good to soft); fared okay with the draw and Oisin Murphy is booked; chance.

runners_data.name: Everatease
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse improving each time and crying out for this longer trip after three 5f efforts
runners_data.comment: Improved RPR with each of his three starts; looks ready for 6f; more appealing than many
runners_data.spotlight: He has improved his RPR with each of his three runs in 5f maidens and the last two times he has looked as though this longer trip would suit; slower ground to contend with but more appealing than many.

runners_data.name: Stay On Tab
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor form across three runs, tongue-tie first time unlikely to transform
runners_data.comment: Poor form in three 5f runs; new trip/tongue-tie not enough to tempt
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in three 5f runs, the latest behind two reopposing rivals at Musselburgh nine days ago; new trip/tongue-tie not enough to tempt.

races.paceDynamic: Undercover Affair will dictate from the front with minimal early pressure, creating a sustainable tempo through the early furlongs. Claret And Blues and Furturra can sit prominent but neither appears keen to challenge for the early lead, allowing the pacesetter breathing room. The lack of genuine speed in this field means the gallop will be steady rather than fierce, with horses spreading out behind the leader. This moderate tempo strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace who can track the leader and pounce late, rather than pure hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Undercover Affair gets an uncontested lead and maintains control
scenarios.body: The leader dictates fractions and has enough in reserve to resist late challenges on ground that suits. Prominent trackers benefit from the measured pace but can't quite reel in the pacesetter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace allows prominent horses to stay close enough to challenge
scenarios.body: Furturra or Claret And Blues sit perfectly positioned behind the leader and have more finishing kick when it matters. The 6f trip plays to their strengths over pure sprinters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace leaves something for a strong finisher stepping up in trip
scenarios.body: Everatease gets the strong gallop he needs from the step up to 6f and times his run perfectly. Hold-up horses find gaps as the field spreads out in the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the debutants shows significantly more ability than expected
scenarios.body: Delete Delete or Stellar Quest proves well above this selling grade on debut with unknown potential. The lack of pace plays into inexperienced hands.

watchPoints.text: Trust In Far and Happy Humpo both fade badly in finishes and look outclassed in current form
Claret And Blues draws stall 12 which compromises his prominent running style around Chester's tight bends
Shaniko wears first-time hood suggesting temperament issues that could manifest in the preliminaries
Several horses stepping up from 5f to 6f for the first time including Furturra who has shown most ability at shorter
Undercover Affair's front-running style perfectly suits Chester but any early pressure could compromise his stamina reserves

races.name: Louise Keegan Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Midnight Rumble
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose best form is on AW but has multiple turf seconds, showing consistency if not quite getting his head in front
runners_data.comment: Sole win (22 races) on AW in 2024; left Alan King for 30,000gns in April; new Flat trip
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win (22 races) was on AW in June 2024; five seconds on turf and bang there on AW (1m3f/1m4f) on last two starts before 30,000gns sale (left Alan King) in April, but this is the first time he's gone beyond that on Flat.

runners_data.name: Venezuelan
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning from 236-day break but retains course form and won his only small-field success when allowed to dominate
runners_data.comment: Left R Beckett for 90,000gns October; staying trips are worth exploring; competitive mark
runners_data.spotlight: Small-field Lingfield maiden last August was his only win but he was on the premises in nearly all his handicaps; tried various headgear on last five starts and switches it again on this first run since leaving Ralph Beckett for 90,000gns in October; unraced beyond 1m4f but staying trips are worth exploring and he has a competitive mark.

runners_data.name: Heathen
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with superior AW record who was close up over this trip at Chester last year off the same mark
runners_data.spotlight: 5-19 on AW and 0-9 on turf; twice close up over 1m4f on turf last year, including off this mark at Chester, but is also a dual 1m6f winner on AW and has at least one piece of 2m form in that sphere; a case can be made if he's tuned up sufficiently after 259 days off; the market may guide.

runners_data.name: Imperial Sovereign
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose sole win came in novice company but has run respectably in competitive handicaps this term
runners_data.comment: Sole win (19 races) was a novice in 2023; running respectably this term
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win (19 races) was a novice in 2023; running respectably this term, drawn wide when never able to challenge in the Chester Plate last time; competitively handicapped but probably not the percentage call.

runners_data.name: Solar Pass
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose wins have come on AW but showed recent form with 1m6f second, though Chester track debut was poor
runners_data.comment: Close second with first-time cheekpieces at Goodwood (2m, good) on latest outing
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have been on AW (latest in March) and her only run at this track did not go well, when favourite over 1m6f on heavy on final start last term; close second with first-time cheekpieces at Goodwood (2m, good) on latest outing, however, is a notable positive.

runners_data.name: Percy Jones
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose four wins were all on Wolverhampton AW, maintaining 0-22 turf record despite multiple seconds
runners_data.comment: 0-22 turf record includes six 2nds (two here); considered each-way in first cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins were on Wolverhampton AW, the latest off a 2lb higher mark last August (1m4f); 0-22 record on turf includes six seconds and two of those (one last year) were at this track; this is his first 2m race for a while but he used to look fully effective over it and, with a run under his belt now this term, he's considered each-way in the first-time cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Believitanducan
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from hurdles with recent 2m Ascot win but lacks any experience of Chester's unique demands
runners_data.comment: Back to Flat with a win at Ascot (2m, good) three weeks ago as 11-8 favourite; up 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Three months off before returning to Flat with a win at Ascot (2m, good; 12 ran) three weeks ago, always prominent as 11-8 favourite; up 4lb and lacks any experience of this track but a huge player if he takes to it.

runners_data.name: Savrola
runners_data.note: Front-runner who was progressive last year over staying trips but returns from seven-month absence after disappointing reappearance
runners_data.comment: Progressive front-runner last year but beaten 30l on recent reappearance (12-1)
runners_data.spotlight: Progressive front-runner last year (over 1m6f, 1m5f and 2m) who finished either first or second in all five of those races, but he wasn't seen after July; 30l defeat on recent reappearance (12-1) suggests he's best watched but his trainer had two jumps winners this week.

runners_data.name: Ouro Preto
runners_data.note: Prominent runner formerly French-trained with decent form but was well beaten on British handicap debut last time
runners_data.comment: Ex-French; well-beaten last on British debut at Hamilton (1m3f, good; 14-1) 15 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: 3-15 when trained in France, the latest win in a claimer at Longchamp (1m4f, very soft) last September; well handicapped judged on peak French efforts but he was a well-beaten last of seven on British debut at Hamilton (1m3f, good; 14-1) 15 days ago; unraced much beyond 1m4f.

runners_data.name: Kuredu King
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 254-day break and hurdles campaign, having won over 1m6f for Gosdens but needs to prove fitness
runners_data.comment: Soundly beaten in both hurdle runs for new yard this spring, given wind surgery in between
runners_data.spotlight: 11.6f and 1m6f handicap winner last year for the Gosdens; however, soundly beaten on both attempts over hurdles for new yard this spring, given wind surgery in between; player if he can tap back into those 2025 performances.

runners_data.name: Dance Time
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose record shows 6-19 on AW but 0-10 on turf, with none of her turf form matching this level
runners_data.comment: None of her turf form matches this mark and her 2nd here last September was on heavy going
runners_data.spotlight: 6-19 on AW but 0-10 on turf; none of her turf form matches this mark and her second here last September was on heavy going; blinkered latest; while moving back up from 1m4f should help, others have more pressing claims.

races.paceDynamic: Venezuelan and Savrola are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early pace from the off, creating an honest gallop throughout this 2m test. With both having recent form showing they can sustain their speed over extended trips, expect a genuine tempo that will stretch the field and prevent any tactical nonsense. The sustained pace will suit horses who can travel strongly in behind and have a proven finishing kick, while those needing things to fall apart up front will struggle. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with stamina who can pick up the pieces when the pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Venezuelan and Savrola engage in a prolonged speed battle from halfway.
scenarios.body: The two leaders will set each other alight and come back to the field in the final two furlongs, allowing closers with stamina to sweep past. Hold-up horses like Believitanducan and Imperial Sovereign can capitalise on their tactical positioning and proven finishing speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Pair Sustain Effort
scenarios.trigger: If either Venezuelan or Savrola can break clear and maintain momentum.
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters proves too strong and kicks clear when the other fades, with their early advantage proving decisive over this stamina test. Their front-running style and course fitness gives them the edge over pursuers who leave their run too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing trackers to pounce.
scenarios.body: Midnight Rumble or Ouro Preto can sit close enough to the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle, then strike when leaders falter. Their prominent style positions them perfectly to capitalise when the race develops into a staying test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Favours Stayers
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace exposes stamina limitations across the field.
scenarios.body: The honest gallop becomes a real slog and only horses with proven stamina over similar distances can cope with the demands. Heathen's AW staying form and Solar Pass's recent 1m6f second suggest they can outlast rivals when it becomes a pure test of stamina.

watchPoints.text: Venezuelan's fitness after 236-day absence could see him fold quickly if he goes too hard early against Savrola
Savrola's reappearance effort was disappointing and he may not recapture last year's progressive form after seven months off
Believitanducan has no Chester experience and may struggle with the tight turns despite his recent Ascot success
Solar Pass's only previous Chester run resulted in a poor effort as favourite over 1m6f on heavy ground
Kuredu King's wind surgery and dual absence from Flat racing makes his fitness and wellbeing a significant unknown

races.name: Virgin Bet Handicap

runners_data.name: Supido
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who benefits from strong pace, 24-day break ideal, recent fifth behind stablemate encouraging
runners_data.comment: Capitalised on good mark here (7.6f) 24 days ago; 4lb rise shouldn't prove beyond him
runners_data.spotlight: Finished close up in fifth in the Britannia Stakes at Royal Ascot last year (1m, good to firm); his 3yo campaign rather fizzled out but he dropped in the weights as a result and took full advantage with his 7.6f success here 24 days ago; well drawn again and a 4lb rise isn't beyond him.

runners_data.name: Korker
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but warning signs of fading in finish, lacks a recent win and 7f may stretch stamina
runners_data.comment: On a dangerous mark but on a long losing run and stamina for 7f not yet assured
runners_data.spotlight: Slow-starter; on a dangerous mark but he is without a win since October 2023 and one 7f run didn't see him improve for the trip.

runners_data.name: Palmar Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-suited to tactical affairs, consistent at this trip with solid course form
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; drops back from Listed company but could find one or two stronger
runners_data.spotlight: Ready winner of a C&D handicap last summer off a 12lb lower mark; better than ever when a close fourth in a Wolverhampton Listed race in March and he faced a stiff task at Haydock three weeks ago; should give his running but could find one or two stronger back in handicap company.

runners_data.name: Roman Dragon
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent course record, may be vulnerable to stamina test at 7f having won over 5f
runners_data.comment: Eighth course win when scoring over 5f three weeks ago; having a rare 7f run; vulnerable
runners_data.spotlight: Enhanced his excellent course record when narrowly landing a 5f handicap at the May meeting; stays 7f but rarely seen at the trip now; may prove vulnerable to stronger stayers.

runners_data.name: The Angel King
runners_data.note: Hold-up style from in-form Ian Williams stable, 24-day break since encouraging Chester sixth
runners_data.comment: Good run behind stablemate Supido here this month; the draw has not been so kind today
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French; low-key stable debut at Haydock in April but he fared much better when sixth, beaten under 3l, behind stablemate Supido here (7.6f, good) 24 days ago; he hasn't fared so kindly with the draw this time.

runners_data.name: Angel Hunter
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing career-best performance, 14-day turnaround after midfield finish
runners_data.comment: 1m AW win on Good Friday was a solid effort; 2 midfield finishes since; career best needed
runners_data.spotlight: Narrow winner of a competitive 1m handicap at Lingfield on Good Friday; two midfield finishes this month and he will need a career best to come out on top in this field.

runners_data.name: Bobby Bennu
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course-winning form but wide draw (stall 16) poses tactical problems
runners_data.comment: Only 8th in this race last year; 4lb lower today but stall 12 not helpful
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner; only eighth in the corresponding race 12 months ago; 4lb lower today but he is drawn wide and this may not be his day.

runners_data.name: Miami Matrix
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making stable debut for new yard, two previous course wins provide confidence
runners_data.comment: Two course wins (7.6f) for Hugo Palmer last summer; encouraging stable debut this month
runners_data.spotlight: Two course wins (7.6f) for Hugo Palmer last summer; respectable fourth on this month's stable debut; should give his running but perhaps vulnerable for win purposes.

runners_data.name: Nizam
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but 80-1 stable debut suggests trainer has stronger fancies in better form
runners_data.comment: Three-time winner in France; low-key stable debut last month; likely best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins and boasted some strong form when trained in France; 80-1 and never threatened on his stable debut six weeks ago; Ian Williams looks to have stronger claims elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Brighton Boy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with course-winning form, confirmed promise when close-up in recent Chester handicap
runners_data.comment: Course winner; led late on at Thirsk 2 weeks ago (7f, good); 3lb higher but should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Course winner (7.6f, soft) for Andrew Balding last summer; not beaten far in the 7.6f handicap won by Supido 24 days ago (poor draw) and confirmed that promise with a Class 3 win at Thirsk a fortnight ago (7f, good); a 3lb rise shouldn't prove beyond him and Warren Fentiman's claim is a bonus.

runners_data.name: Elements Of Fire
runners_data.note: Front-runner making turf debut for season, well-drawn to attack but faces significant class rise
runners_data.comment: 4-4 on AW but unplaced both turf starts; good draw; not fully exposed
runners_data.spotlight: Front-runner; 4-4 on AW but unplaced in both turf runs; he will need a career best to come out on top but he is well drawn to attack and still has low mileage.

runners_data.name: Midnight Strike
runners_data.note: Prominent style but poor draw disadvantage overcome today, stable debut effort forgettable at 100-1
runners_data.comment: Useful 2yo; well-beaten 100-1 shot in C&D handicap on stable debut; better draw today
runners_data.spotlight: Useful 2yo for Joseph O'Brien; poorly drawn and finished well beaten in a C&D handicap on stable debut this month (100-1); he has fared better with the draw today but others still look more appealing.

runners_data.name: Lexington Jet
runners_data.note: Front-runner transformed by blinkers this year, wide draw may force early exertion against Elements Of Fire
runners_data.comment: Three 1m wins at Chelmsford, making all on each occasion; Class 2 may find him out
runners_data.spotlight: Transformed by blinkers this year, making all in three 1m handicaps at Chelmsford; well drawn to attack but he will need a big personal best to score at this level.

races.paceDynamic: Elements Of Fire and Lexington Jet will attack from the gates, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the early lead in this 13-runner handicap. Elements Of Fire has the better draw (stall 11) while Lexington Jet sits wider (stall 18), but both have the pace to reach the rail early. With prominent runners like Palmar Bay, Bobby Bennu, Brighton Boy and Midnight Strike sitting just off the pace, a solid gallop is assured through the middle stages. This honest tempo will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver their finishing kicks, making this a race that strongly favours late closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire and Lexington Jet go hard early and the prominent runners track them closely
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and creates the perfect setup for hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks in the final 2f. Roman Dragon, Supido and The Angel King benefit most from this searching test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Emerging
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go steady early and the prominent horses refuse to commit
scenarios.body: A messy, stop-start affair develops where positioning becomes crucial and those with tactical pace gain the advantage. Brighton Boy and Palmar Bay are perfectly placed to capitalise on the changing tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runners Steal March
scenarios.trigger: If Elements Of Fire gets an uncontested lead and the field settles too far back
scenarios.body: The pace-setter gets loose on the lead and builds an unassailable advantage, holding on grimly as the closers mount their challenge. Elements Of Fire's low mileage and good draw make this possible despite the class rise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Favours Speedsters
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners are restrained early and no genuine pace materialises
scenarios.body: The lack of tempo turns this into a sprint finish where horses with natural speed gain the crucial edge. Roman Dragon's 5f course form and any prominent runner with gate speed benefit from the tactical affair.

watchPoints.text: Elements Of Fire and Lexington Jet must be monitored for early speed battle that could compromise both front-runners
Roman Dragon may struggle for stamina at 7f having shown best recent form over minimum trip
Ian Williams trio of Supido, The Angel King and Nizam represents 25% of field with stable in excellent form
Bobby Bennu and Lexington Jet face wide draws that force them to use early energy to gain position
Korker's recent form suggests fading tendency in finishes which 7f distance may expose further

races.name: John Smith's Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Ruby's Angel
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with Oisin Murphy aboard, strong recent form but faces stamina test if pace gets hectic
runners_data.comment: Good 2nd to Cherry Baker here on her reappearance; drawn 1 then but has stall 12 this time
runners_data.spotlight: Won a big-field nursery (6f, good to firm) at last season's Ebor meeting; good second to Cherry Baker over C&D on her seasonal reappearance and 4lb better off with that rival today; drawn in stall 1 on that occasion but she's widest today which makes it easy enough to look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Tarot
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 232-day break under in-form Roger Varian, bred for improvement but fitness question
runners_data.comment: Form of 6f AW win last October boosted since; more to come but stall 11 not ideal
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in her first three 2yo starts; made all to win a 6f fillies' novice at Kempton when last seen in October; bred to carry on progressing and the second and third from that Kempton race won their next start; stall 11 makes life tough though.

runners_data.name: Champonie
runners_data.note: Closer who has won her last two starts, stepping up from lower grades but George Boughey yard firing
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over 6f; found 5f inadequate here three weeks ago; capable of better back at this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Won 6f AW events on her first two starts; lost her unbeaten record but enhanced her reputation when keeping on for sixth in a 5f handicap here (good ground) three weeks ago; the return to this trip will suit and she remains capable of better.

runners_data.name: Hayynah
runners_data.note: Front-runner with headgear applied, likely to press early pace but stamina doubts over this trip
runners_data.comment: Off the mark at Southwell (5f) in February but ran poorly on handicap debut latest
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the sixth attempt when beating eight rivals in a 5f novice at Southwell in February; had earlier chased home Champonie at Newcastle but had an experience advantage that day; needs to bounce back from a low-key Southwell run (5f; handicap debut) seven weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Evie Ross
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with blinkers fitted, bouncing back from poor seasonal debut for consistent Clive Cox
runners_data.comment: Better than the result here on this month's handicap debut; draw could have been kinder
runners_data.spotlight: Easily won a 5f maiden at Chepstow on her second 2yo run; never in the hunt behind Cherry Baker on her seasonal/handicap debut here 24 days ago but the run wasn't without hope, drawn wide in stall 12, racing freely under restraint and not enjoying a clear passage at a crucial time; stall 9 again not ideal but she's one to keep an eye on as the season progresses.

runners_data.name: Zighy
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who found improvement last time, will ensure strong early gallop
runners_data.comment: Progressive filly who should appreciate the return to 6f; stable also run Champonie
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt as a 2yo, winning a 6f fillies' novice decisively; stronger form when coming from off the pace to win a Class 4 handicap at Southwell last month but she was beaten fair and square at Yarmouth two weeks later (7f, good to firm); return to 6f can help but Champonie may prove the yard's main hope.

runners_data.name: Cherry Baker
runners_data.note: Pure closer who won here 24 days ago with perfect tactical ride, Cieren Fallon knows her well
runners_data.comment: Cosy C&D win on handicap debut this month; 5lb rise/wider stall demand further progress
runners_data.spotlight: Found the Group 3 Nell Gwyn Stakes all too much for her on her reappearance but she left it behind on her handicap debut, enjoying a charmed run up the inside to score comfortably in a C&D handicap 24 days ago; up 5lb and drawn even wider today; another career best is required.

runners_data.name: Slay Queen
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning to form, handles varying ground conditions for powerful Hannon stable
runners_data.comment: Two 6f wins last year but she made a low-key return to action at Newmarket this month
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 6f last summer; low-key return to action at Newmarket four weeks ago (6f, good to firm; handles much slower); still 5lb higher than for her handicap win; vulnerable.

runners_data.name: Rogue Temptation
runners_data.comment: Gone the wrong way following a good third at Doncaster on her nursery debut;
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well for third on her nursery debut at Doncaster (6.5f, good to soft) last September and she turns up here off a 7lb lower mark; that is a consequence of some disappointing runs since, including both her outings in 2026.

runners_data.name: Trust Amy
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer fresh from Listed company just 8 days ago, trainer Gary Hanmer winless in last 13 attempts
runners_data.comment: C&D winner but her handicap efforts don't suggest she is the answer today despite stall 1
runners_data.spotlight: C&D win last September before a good fifth in Listed company at Doncaster (6f, heavy); didn't run badly in another Listed event on last week's reappearance but her handicap runs don't suggest she is the answer, even from the inside stall.

runners_data.name: Saffron Dandy
runners_data.note: Prominent type whose recent turf form has been disappointing, better on artificial surfaces
runners_data.comment: Chance on this year's AW best but she was disappointing back on turf 13 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Of interest on this year's AW best; latest Ripon run was underwhelming though and others look open to greater progress.

runners_data.name: Fizzy Cristal
runners_data.note: Closer stepping up significantly in class with 3lb claiming apprentice, recent course winner but outclassed here
runners_data.comment: Two 6f wins at Newcastle, including Class 5 handicap 11 days ago; turf form lags behind
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with a 6f win at Newcastle and she was back on the scoresheet over that C&D 11 days ago; up from Class 5 today and her turf efforts leave her with something to find.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Angel, Zighy, and Hayynah will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with Ruby's Angel likely to grab the early lead given her tactical speed and Murphy's aggressive style. The pace will be honest throughout with multiple front-runners committed to racing prominently, creating a testing stamina examination over this stiff 6f at Chester. Hold-up horses like Cherry Baker, Tarot, and Champonie will get the perfect setup to unleash late challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up performers who can capitalize on the expected pace collapse in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong pace collapses late
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners go too hard early and tie up
scenarios.body: The honest gallop sets up perfectly for closers who can time their runs to perfection in Chester's unique straight. Hold-up horses with tactical speed will have first run on the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates tired field
scenarios.trigger: If Ruby's Angel gets easy fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: Murphy's tactical nous allows Ruby's Angel to control the tempo before quickening away from a weakened field. The pace-setters who went with her early will lack the finishing punch to respond.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-race pace surge creates chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent racers increase tempo at halfway
scenarios.body: Slay Queen and Saffron Dandy inject pace from prominent positions, stretching the field and creating gaps for smart tactical rides. This tempo shift catches both pure front-runners and hold-up horses off guard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow early allows closer domination
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners are more cautious than expected
scenarios.body: A steadier early pace allows the hold-up brigade to get closer than ideal before unleashing devastating late kicks. The race becomes a pure finishing contest where class tells in the final 100 yards.

watchPoints.text: Ruby's Angel and Zighy dictate early fractions - if they go too fast both will stop quickly
Cherry Baker gets the same charmed passage up the rail that won her the race here 24 days ago
Tarot handles the return from her 232-day absence as Roger Varian horses often need the run
Hayynah's headgear helps her settle better than her natural front-running style suggests
Trust Amy backs up quickly from her Listed effort just 8 days ago

races.name: General Elliot Croft Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Bemersyde
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with proven stamina who should benefit from the expected strong pace under Silvestre De Sousa
runners_data.comment: Two minor honours before a lesser show latest; interesting upped to 1m2f on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Minor honours over 1m at Newmarket (good) and Windsor (good to firm) on first two starts, before a lesser show under 7lb claimer on latest outing; one to note stepped up to 1m2f for this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Gatehouse
runners_data.note: Another closer with solid AW form at this trip, though returning from a 27-day break for struggling stable
runners_data.comment: Two AW wins before put firmly in his place on turf debut at Newmarket (good to firm)
runners_data.spotlight: Bright start to career on AW included a novice win at Chelmsford (1m2f) in December and short-head handicap win at Southwell (1m) in April; however, he was put firmly in his place on turf debut at Newmarket (good to firm) four weeks ago when a return to 1m2f should have suited.

runners_data.name: Blue Noon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who looked green when in front last time but could benefit from more aggressive tactics today
runners_data.comment: Minor honours each time; green in front latest and carried her head a bit high; early days
runners_data.spotlight: Minor honours in maiden/novice events at Leicester (7f), Newmarket (1m2f) and Salisbury (1m3f); led over 2f out last time but looked green in front and carried her head a bit high; early days, going handicapping first time.

runners_data.name: Knowledge
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced prominent performer returning after 49 days off, may need the run despite his obvious ability
runners_data.comment: 1m debut winner on Southwell AW but last of five in Yarmouth novice (1m2f, good); gelded
runners_data.spotlight: Benefited from the runner-up hanging sharply left when narrow winner of 1m novice at Southwell (AW) in January on debut; outsider of five when he finished last in novice at Yarmouth (1m2f, good; bred to stay) seven weeks ago, behind talented rivals but it did not advertise his claims; gelded before this handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Timber Twelve
runners_data.note: Front-runner who must bounce back from disappointing Epsom effort where he failed to see out the trip
runners_data.comment: 2-2 on AW but a lesser front-running effort at Epsom (8.5f, good) on turf/handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Made most to win 1m novices on AW at Kempton in September and Southwell in March; that perfect start was followed by a lesser front-running effort at Epsom (8.5f, good) on turf/handicap debut but he looks bred for 1m2f.

runners_data.name: Mayaada
runners_data.note: Most experienced runner with good recent form, versatile tactics allow her to adapt to any pace scenario
runners_data.comment: 12 races but best form on last two; won when upped to 1m2f at Salisbury on latest
runners_data.spotlight: After 12 races, for two wins, she should be far more exposed than today's rivals; however, her best form was on last two outings when second at Epsom (8.5f, good) and winning with a steady late bid at Salisbury (upped to 1m2f, good; 4lb higher today) and that earns respect.

runners_data.name: Advance Twentyfive
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has shown little this season and needs to recapture his juvenile form
runners_data.comment: Best form in valuable 7f sales races as 2yo but he's been nowhere near repeating it
runners_data.spotlight: Second in a maiden here last September; best form in valuable sales races (also 7f) on next two outings but nowhere near repeating it in his two starts this term; hampered early in a York handicap last time (7f; 22-1) and this is a major rethink on his trip, but none too persuasive.

runners_data.name: Folk Pageant
runners_data.note: Natural leader with decent recent form who could benefit from the low weight of 127lbs
runners_data.comment: One poor run from four starts; won two, including Newmarket handicap (1m2f, good); up 3lb
runners_data.spotlight: Last of nine on handicap debut at Southwell (1m, AW; 11-1) in March but won starts either side in a maiden at Lingfield (1m, AW; made all) and eight-runner handicap at Newmarket (1m2f, good; always prominent); the latter was by a short head at 25-1 but she's gone up just 3lb since that rallying display and that does not look harsh.

runners_data.name: Crockham Heath
runners_data.note: Front-runner much better on AW than turf, turf form gives cause for concern despite class jockey booking
runners_data.comment: Two front-running wins on AW looked promising but were way better than both turf efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Front-running wins in a Southwell novice (1m) and Wolverhampton handicap (9.4f; with authority) in his only two AW races; those were way better than turf performances at Newmarket on debut and in 1m2f handicap (good to firm) on latest outing, which is a concern even though these are early days.

runners_data.name: Home Hero
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from a 268-day layoff, hard to assess current ability after such a long absence
runners_data.comment: A fascinating handicap newcomer who needs a close look for any strength in the betting
runners_data.spotlight: Finished closer each time in his three-race 2yo career and met trouble in running when fourth of nine at Haydock (1m, good) on final outing, looking on an even keel only very late in the day when running on well; gelded the following day; highly likely to stay and he's a fascinating handicap newcomer who needs a close look for any strength behind him in the betting.

runners_data.name: Carwyn
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has shown a tendency to fade in the finish, may struggle to pick up leaders if pace is strong
runners_data.comment: Well beaten on Irish handicap debut and the same story this month on both British starts
runners_data.spotlight: Twice showed fair form at 1m in his four Irish races last term for Ger Lyons; well beaten on handicap debut there, however, and it was the same story this month on both British starts.

races.paceDynamic: Timber Twelve, Folk Pageant and Crockham Heath will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with all three natural front-runners likely to dispute the early lead over this stamina-testing 1m2½f trip. The sustained pace will stretch the field and test stamina reserves, particularly as Chester's tight turns add to the physical demands. This genuine gallop will suit horses with proven staying power who can finish strongly from off the pace. The race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with tactical pace who can position just behind the leaders before striking late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners go forward and maintain a searching gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the leaders in the final furlong, allowing hold-up horses with stamina to pick up the pieces. Bemersyde and Gatehouse, both proven over this trip with finishing kicks, will benefit most from this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters gets first run and kicks clear while the others tie up
scenarios.body: Folk Pageant or Timber Twelve could exploit their natural speed advantage if they can steal a march on their pace rivals. The winner would need to have enough left to resist late challenges from the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but one horse positions perfectly just behind the leaders
scenarios.body: A horse like Blue Noon or Knowledge could benefit from racing handy to the pace without doing the donkey work. They would be perfectly placed to strike when the front-runners begin to tire in the home straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the three pace-setters go too fast early and all come back to the field
scenarios.body: The race would become a sprint finish where any horse with a turn of foot could win. This unlikely scenario would suit horses with natural speed regardless of their usual running style.

watchPoints.text: Timber Twelve and Folk Pageant could set unsustainable fractions if they duel for the early lead over this stamina-testing trip
Gatehouse and Knowledge both return from significant layoffs which could blunt their finishing kicks despite their obvious class
Crockham Heath's poor turf record suggests he may not handle the surface switch from his preferred all-weather tracks
Blue Noon showed greenness when hitting the front last time, watch for more confident tactics from the Hannon team today
Mayaada's versatile running style makes her dangerous if connections can find the right tactical approach from her wide draw
